body.name: v0.79.6 — Track every AI token
body.body:
## Track every AI token. Keep it local.

TokenTracker's core is a local token usage and cost dashboard for 27 AI coding
tools. This release makes that value clearer while bringing its unique desktop
experience closer to the front:

- One dashboard for token trends, model and project costs, activity heatmaps,
  context breakdowns, and rate-limit windows.
- Native macOS menu bar and Windows tray apps, plus the cross-platform CLI.
- Four desktop widgets for usage, activity, top models, and limits.
- A desktop pet powered by real token activity and 15 achievement tracks.
- Local-first by default. TokenTracker never reads prompts, responses, or code.

Try the CLI without installing it globally:

```bash
npx --yes tokentracker-cli
```

Or download `TokenTrackerBar.dmg`, `TokenTracker-Setup.exe`, or the portable
Windows ZIP below.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mm7894215/TokenTracker/compare/v0.79.5...v0.79.6
